Description: Create or sign in to Ravenna to access the Malden Catholic application and admissions events.
Required document: Ravenna account
Deadline: The current Malden Catholic admissions landing page says application and acceptance dates are to be announced.

Description: Take the Archdiocese of Boston HSPT once and designate Malden Catholic to receive the results. The linked STS registry currently lists Malden Catholic test dates of November 7, November 21, and December 12, 2026. The Admissions Process page still displays 2025 dates and must not be used for the 2026 testing cycle.
Required document: HSPT registration and results
Deadline: MC test dates: November 7, November 21, or December 12, 2026. Registration closes November 5, November 19, or December 10 respectively at 11:59 PM CST. Fee: $40.

Description: Complete the Malden Catholic application in Ravenna.
Required document: Online application
Deadline: The current Malden Catholic admissions landing page says application and acceptance dates are to be announced.

Description: Submit 7th- and 8th-grade transcripts and two academic recommendations. Ravenna can send recommendation forms electronically to school officials; an optional character recommendation may also be submitted.
Required document: 7th- and 8th-grade transcripts; 2 academic recommendations; optional character recommendation
Deadline: The current application deadline is not published.

Description: An eighth grader may register for the Lancer for a Day program through Ravenna, then complete the separate shadow questionnaire after registration.
Required document: Ravenna event registration; shadow questionnaire after registration
Deadline: The Visit MC page says 2026 Shadow Day dates are to be announced.

Description: Complete enrollment after acceptance to secure a seat. The current admissions landing page says the application and acceptance timeline is to be announced; do not reuse the class-of-2030 February 1 line still present on the Admissions Process page as a 2026-27 deadline.
Required document: Enrollment contract, deposit, and registration fee as assigned in the enrollment packet
Deadline: Current 2026-27 acceptance and enrollment dates are not published on the admissions landing page.

Applicant type: Current MC Middle School student continuing to Grade 9
Description: Students in good standing are welcomed and encouraged to continue at Malden Catholic. The HSPT is not required for students transitioning from Malden Catholic Grade 8 to Grade 9. The public FAQ does not publish the remaining continuation or enrollment steps, so confirm them with Admission.
Required document: Continuation or enrollment materials assigned by Malden Catholic
Deadline: No current public continuation deadline is listed.

Description: Create or sign in to Ravenna to access the Malden Catholic application and admissions events.
Required document: Ravenna account
Deadline: The current Malden Catholic admissions landing page says application and acceptance dates are to be announced.

Description: Complete the Malden Catholic application in Ravenna.
Required document: Online application
Deadline: The current application deadline is not published.

Description: The public Admissions Process page requests 5th- and 6th-grade transcripts, two academic recommendations, and recent standardized results: MCAS for public-school students or MAP for parochial-school students. Contact Admission if the school uses a different test. An optional character recommendation may also be submitted.
Required document: 5th- and 6th-grade transcripts; 2 academic recommendations; MCAS or MAP results; optional character recommendation
Deadline: The current application deadline is not published.

Description: Attend a Middle School Open House or another admissions visit. Register through Ravenna or contact Mea Mustone.
Required document: Ravenna event registration
Deadline: Current posted Middle School Open House dates are October 7, November 12, and December 16; the public page does not print the year beside these dates. Confirm the event year in Ravenna.

Description: Complete enrollment after acceptance to secure a seat. The current admissions landing page says the application and acceptance timeline is to be announced; do not treat the February 27 line on the Admissions Process page as a confirmed 2026-27 date.
Required document: Enrollment contract, deposit, and registration fee as assigned in the enrollment packet
Deadline: Current 2026-27 acceptance and enrollment dates are not published on the admissions landing page.

Description: Create or sign in to Ravenna and begin the transfer application.
Required document: Online application
Deadline: No current transfer deadline is published; contact Admission.

Description: Obtain the Transcript Record Form through Ravenna and bring it to the current teacher, principal, or guidance counselor. The old public PDF linked on the Admissions Process page returns 404 and must not be used.
Required document: Transcript Record Form from Ravenna; current-school academic record
Deadline: Submit as part of the transfer application; no current transfer deadline is published.

Description: Provide two academic recommendation letters. An optional character recommendation may also be submitted.
Required document: 2 academic recommendations; optional character recommendation
Deadline: No current transfer deadline is published; contact Admission.

Description: Provide an official discipline report from the current school.
Required document: Official discipline report
Deadline: No current transfer deadline is published; contact Admission.

Description: Provide the most recent standardized scores. The public page lists HSPT, SSAT, PLAN, and PSAT and says Admission may request other documents based on individual circumstances.
Required document: Recent standardized test scores; any additional documents requested by Admission
Deadline: No current transfer deadline is published; contact Admission.

Requirement: Arrange an interview and personalized tour
Description: Contact the Office of Admission for an interview and personalized school tour.
Required document: Interview and tour appointment
Deadline: Contact Admission directly.

Description: Create or sign in to Ravenna. Applicants must be academically qualified, have completed the equivalent of Grade 8, 9, or 10, and have functional English. The same official page contains two different September-entry deadlines, so the date must be confirmed with International Programs. Applicants have 21 days after receiving an acceptance letter to enroll.
Required document: Online application
Deadline: Official-page conflict: September entry is listed as June 1 near Step 1 and May 1 near Step 7; January entry is consistently October 30. Enroll within 21 days after acceptance.

Description: Submit IELTS or TOEFL iBT results. Malden Catholic's TOEFL code is 2065.
Required document: IELTS or TOEFL iBT results
Deadline: Submit with the application; confirm the applicable entrance deadline because the official page conflicts for September entry.

Description: The student must be represented by an agent, host family, or guardian in the Boston area. Upon acceptance, that representative accompanies the student to the interview during required International Orientation. Malden Catholic does not provide boarding facilities.
Required document: Approved agent, host-family, guardian, or Boston-area family-member information
Deadline: Required before enrollment and orientation.

Description: Provide a copy of the student's passport and visa.
Required document: Passport and visa copy
Deadline: Submit with the application.

Description: Obtain the Transcript Record Form through Ravenna and bring it to the current teacher, principal, or guidance counselor. The old public PDF linked by the school returns 404 and must not be used.
Required document: Transcript Record Form from Ravenna; academic transcript
Deadline: Submit with the application.

Description: Provide one recommendation from an English teacher and one from a mathematics teacher.
Required document: English-teacher recommendation; mathematics-teacher recommendation
Deadline: Submit with the application.

Description: The official page heading says to provide a copy of the birth certificate, while the text beneath it requests a recent physical or health record, immunizations, and TB-test results. Treat the public wording as internally inconsistent and confirm the exact packet with International Programs.
Required document: Birth certificate; recent physical or health record; immunization record; TB-test results, subject to International Programs confirmation
Deadline: Submit with the application.

Requirement: Complete enrollment and attend International Student Orientation
Description: Accepted students submit the Enrollment Contract and Student Information Form. Orientation occurs about two weeks before the academic year and is mandatory for students, host families, and agents. Students bring their visa, passport, and completed Student Information Form.
Required document: Enrollment Contract; Student Information Form; visa; passport
Deadline: Enroll within 21 days after acceptance; orientation is approximately two weeks before the academic year begins.

Description: High School tuition is $22,365. The new-student registration fee is $200 and non-refundable; the graduation fee is $275 and non-refundable.
Required document: FACTS payment-plan enrollment or payment information
Deadline: Pay in full July 1; two-payment plan July 1 and September 1; or 10 EFT payments July through April on the 5th or 20th.

Description: Middle School tuition is $20,975. The new-student registration fee is $200 and non-refundable.
Required document: FACTS payment-plan enrollment or payment information
Deadline: Pay in full July 1; two-payment plan July 1 and September 1; or 10 EFT payments July through April on the 5th or 20th.

Requirement: Review international tuition and enrollment fee
Description: International tuition is $27,865, plus a non-refundable $1,500 enrollment fee. Malden Catholic does not provide boarding. Students must apply through an approved agency or have a family member living in the Boston area; the approved-agencies PDF currently linked by the school returns 404.
Required document: Enrollment and payment materials assigned after acceptance
Deadline: International applicants have 21 days after receiving an acceptance letter to enroll; the public page does not state a full tuition-payment schedule.

Description: Submit a complete FACTS application, including all requested federal tax returns, W-2s, and other documentation. Only complete applications are reviewed. Families reapply each year.
Required document: FACTS application; federal tax returns; W-2s; all requested documents
Deadline: December 19 priority deadline; the public page does not print a year beside the deadline. Award notice is sent in early February.

Description: Submit a complete FACTS application, including all requested federal tax returns, W-2s, and other documentation. Only complete applications are reviewed. Families reapply each year.
Required document: FACTS application; federal tax returns; W-2s; all requested documents
Deadline: December 19 priority deadline; the public page does not print a year beside the deadline. Award notice is sent in late February.

Description: Submit a complete FACTS application, including all requested federal tax returns, W-2s, and other documentation. Only complete applications are reviewed. Families reapply each year.
Required document: FACTS application; federal tax returns; W-2s; all requested documents
Deadline: March 15 deadline; the public page does not print a year beside the deadline.

Description: The official Affording MC page says academic merit scholarships are awarded without a separate application based on the Archdiocesan entrance exam, academic records, and recommendations. The official FAQ simultaneously says Malden Catholic does not accept merit scholarships at this time. Do not state either policy as settled until Admission or Student Accounts confirms it.
Required document: No separate application according to Affording MC; confirmation required because the FAQ conflicts
Deadline: No application deadline is stated; confirmation required.
Contact person: Office of Admission; Student Accounts Department
